milestones.claim: Auto-run Codex as an independent read-only reviewer and capture a structured materialHash-bound verdict through the existing capture path
milestones.doneMeans: cross_host_review runs a read-only Codex review (stdin-pipe), parses only the structured JSON verdict, records a codex-provider verdict bound to the current materialHash via submitLocalVerdict, and fails closed (blocked) on unparseable/schema-invalid/materialHash-mismatched output

milestones.claim: Combine host-A and host-B verdicts into a joint decision that surfaces finding-level disagreements
milestones.doneMeans: diffFindings + jointDecision report onlyHostA/onlyHostB findings and block when any single-host finding or non-pass decision exists; pass only when both hosts pass and there is no disagreement; command registered
